CASOS # ============================================================================== casos = { "π/4 y 9π/4": { "Omega1": np.pi/4, "Omega2": 9*np.pi/4, "label1": "π/4", "label2": "9π/4", }, "π/3 y 7π/3": { "Omega1": np.pi/3, "Omega2": 7*np.pi/3, "label1": "π/3", "label2": "7π/3", }, "3π/4 y 11π/4": { "Omega1": 3*np.pi/4, "Omega2": 11*np.pi/4, "label1": "3π/4", "label2": "11π/4", }, "-π/4 y 7π/4": { "Omega1": -np.pi/4, "Omega2": 7*np.pi/4, "label1": "-π/4", "label2": "7π/4", }, } caso0 = list(casos.keys())[0] Omega1 = casos[caso0]["Omega1"] Omega2 = casos[caso0]["Omega2"] x1_disc = np.cos(Omega1*n) x2_disc = np.cos(Omega2*n) x1_cont = np.cos(Omega1*t) x2_cont = np.cos(Omega2*t) source_disc = ColumnDataSource(data=dict( n=n, zero=np.zeros_like(n), x1_disc=x1_disc, x2_disc=x2_disc, )) source_cont = ColumnDataSource(data=dict( t=t, x1_cont=x1_cont, x2_cont=x2_cont, )) # ============================================================================== # 3. FIGURA # ============================================================================== p = figure( height=470, width=600, title="Ambigüedad en frecuencia: continuo distinto, discreto igual", tools="pan,wheel_zoom,reset" ) # Envolventes continuas p.line( "t", "x1_cont", source=source_cont, line_width=2, color="navy", alpha=0.55, line_dash="dashed", legend_label="cos(Ω₁ t)" ) p.line( "t", "x2_cont", source=source_cont, line_width=2, color="firebrick", alpha=0.55, line_dash="dashed", legend_label="cos(Ω₂ t)" ) # Señal discreta Ω1 p.segment( "n", "zero", "n", "x1_disc", source=source_disc, line_width=2, color="navy", alpha=0.35 ) p.scatter( "n", "x1_disc", source=source_disc, size=9, color="navy", legend_label="cos(Ω₁ n)" ) # Señal discreta Ω2 p.segment( "n", "zero", "n", "x2_disc", source=source_disc, line_width=3, color="firebrick", alpha=0.55 ) p.scatter( "n", "x2_disc", source=source_disc, size=12, color="firebrick", fill_alpha=0.25, line_width=2, legend_label="cos(Ω₂ n)" ) p.legend.location = "top_right" p.legend.click_policy = "hide" p.grid.grid_line_alpha = 0.25 style_math_axes( p, x_range=(n_min - 1, n_max + 1), y_range=(-1.35, 1.35), xlabel="t o n", ylabel="amplitud" ) add_math_ticks( p, yticks=[-1, 1], ytick_labels=["-1", "1"], tick_len=5 ) # ============================================================================== # 4. CONTROLES # ============================================================================== caso_select = Select( title="Frecuencias comparadas", value=caso0, options=list(casos.keys()), width=230 ) info = Div(width=600) info.text = """ Ambigüedad en frecuencia discreta
Ω₁ = π/4,    Ω₂ = 9π/4

Las curvas discontinuas muestran las señales continuas cos(Ω₁t) y cos(Ω₂t). Son distintas.

Sin embargo, las muestras en los enteros coinciden: cos(Ω₁n)=cos(Ω₂n). """ # ============================================================================== # 5. CALLBACK # ============================================================================== callback = CustomJS( args=dict( source_disc=source_disc, source_cont=source_cont, caso_select=caso_select, info=info ), code=""" const data_disc = source_disc.data; const data_cont = source_cont.data; const n = data_disc["n"]; const t = data_cont["t"]; const casos = { "π/4 y 9π/4": { Omega1: Math.PI/4, Omega2: 9*Math.PI/4, label1: "π/4", label2: "9π/4", }, "π/3 y 7π/3": { Omega1: Math.PI/3, Omega2: 7*Math.PI/3, label1: "π/3", label2: "7π/3", }, "3π/4 y 11π/4": { Omega1: 3*Math.PI/4, Omega2: 11*Math.PI/4, label1: "3π/4", label2: "11π/4", }, "-π/4 y 7π/4": { Omega1: -Math.PI/4, Omega2: 7*Math.PI/4, label1: "-π/4", label2: "7π/4", }, }; const caso = casos[caso_select.value]; const Omega1 = caso.Omega1; const Omega2 = caso.Omega2; const x1_disc = []; const x2_disc = []; const x1_cont = []; const x2_cont = []; const diff = []; for (let i = 0; i < n.length; i++) { const ni = n[i]; const a = Math.cos(Omega1*ni); const b = Math.cos(Omega2*ni); x1_disc.push(a); x2_disc.push(b); diff.push(Math.abs(a - b)); } for (let i = 0; i < t.length; i++) { const ti = t[i]; x1_cont.push(Math.cos(Omega1*ti)); x2_cont.push(Math.cos(Omega2*ti)); } data_disc["x1_disc"] = x1_disc; data_disc["x2_disc"] = x2_disc; data_cont["x1_cont"] = x1_cont; data_cont["x2_cont"] = x2_cont; const max_diff = Math.max(...diff); info.text = ` Ambigüedad en frecuencia discreta
Ω₁ = ${caso.label1},    Ω₂ = ${caso.label2}

Las curvas discontinuas representan las señales continuas cos(Ω₁t) y cos(Ω₂t).
En continuo son señales distintas porque oscilan a velocidades diferentes.

Pero al evaluar sólo en enteros, t=n, las muestras coinciden exactamente:

cos(Ω₁n)=cos(Ω₂n)

Diferencia máxima entre las muestras: ${max_diff.toExponential(2)}. `; source_disc.change.emit(); source_cont.change.emit(); """ ) caso_select.js_on_change("value", callback) # ============================================================================== # 6.
